summary: Recent discussions in the Spark community focus on expanding data source capabilities with a proposed built‑in ADBC data source, while an AI‑driven code review bot is being trialed for new pull requests.  Parallel proposals aim to unify UDF execution across languages and to optimize joins by performing on‑demand lookups against external storage.  A separate thread addresses a type‑expansion limitation in Spark SQL when altering VARCHAR column lengths.

highlights.text: Proposal to add a built‑in ADBC data source to Spark, complementing the existing JDBC source and enabling columnar reads and writes
Trial of an AI code review bot using Claude to analyze diffs and post inline comments on new Spark pull requests

sources.title: [DISCUSS] Automated AI code review on new Spark PRs (trial)

highlights.text: Introduction of a language‑agnostic UDF protocol for Spark Connect, allowing UDFs to run across multiple programming languages

sources.title: SPIP: Language-agnostic UDF Protocol for Spark

highlights.text: Proposal for an External Lookup Join strategy that performs on‑demand lookups against external storage to reduce latency
